name: actions/button
title: Button
description: The base button every other action builds on.

files.content:
export { Button } from './Button';
export type { ButtonProps, ButtonSize, ButtonVariant } from './Button';

keyboard.action: Move focus to and from the button.

notes: A native `<button>` with `type="button"` by default, so it never submits a form by accident.
Small buttons are 32 px tall, above the 24 px minimum target; the default is 40 px and large is 48 px.
With `aria-disabled`, clicks are ignored but the button stays in the Tab order and keeps its name.
In forced-colours mode the button gets a system-coloured border.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The 1 px press dip is removed; colour changes stay.
